signal: DataHub closed a $35M Series B led by Bessemer in May 2025 and added a CFO, Field CTO, VP Product and VP Engineering across 2025-2026 to scale its AI data catalog.

email.body1:
Justin, saw DataHub closed a $35M Series B and has been stacking GTM and product leadership.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market accounts in the West than the team can cover before the new hires ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for DataHub off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Justin, quick follow-up for DataHub.

Post-Series-B, the pipeline target for your region usually jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings US West needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Justin, last bit of proof for DataHub.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how DataHub's reply rate likely compares to other data infrastructure startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Justin, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch from raise to hiring is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your West region? I'll tailor it to DataHub either way.
